Section 01 — The Threat

What Spyware
Can Do to You

Programs exist right now that secretly record every key you press, take screenshots every 30 seconds, turn on your camera without the indicator light, and read every message you send — then silently transmit it all to a stranger.

⌨️

Keylogger

Records every key you press — every password, every search, every message typed. Sent to the attacker in real time.

🖥️

Screen Capture

Takes a screenshot every 30 seconds. The attacker sees your screen exactly as you see it — private documents, chats, everything.

📷

Camera Access

Activates your camera silently — without the indicator light. Records video. Sends it. You never know it happened.

🎙️

Microphone

Listens to conversations around your device. Records audio even when you're not using any app.

💬

Message Access

Reads your WhatsApp, emails, browser history, saved passwords — after they're already decrypted on your screen.

🕵️

Stalkerware

Tracks your real-time location, monitors calls, and builds a profile of your daily routine. Often installed by someone you know.

Section 02 — Our Services

Three Ways We
Protect Your School

Eidolon offers three professional privacy protection services specifically designed for schools, parents, and IT administrators.

Service 01

Device Permission Audit

From $299 / audit

We review every app and program installed on school devices — checking what permissions each one has requested. Camera? Microphone? Location? Browser history? We flag anything suspicious and deliver a full report with recommended actions.

  • Full app permission scan
  • Risk-level report for each app

  • Completed in 2 hours per device
Service 02 — Most Popular

Privacy Awareness Workshop

$499 / session

A 60-minute workshop for parents and school staff on how spyware works, what warning signs to look for, how to check device permissions, and how to report concerns. Includes a take-home privacy checklist and a safe app installation guide.

  • 60-minute live workshop
  • Available online or in-person
  • Privacy checklist handout
  • Safe app installation guide
  • Up to 40 attendees per session
Service 03

Monthly Monitoring Report

$149 / month

Eidolon monitors school devices monthly for unusual permission changes, new unknown apps, unusual data transmission patterns, and background processes that should not be running. A report is delivered to the IT manager with immediate alerts if anything critical is detected.

  • Monthly automated scan
  • Immediate alert notifications
  • IT manager dashboard access
  • Trend analysis over time
  • Emergency response guidance

The Pegasus
Case Study

Pegasus was built by NSO Group and sold to governments as a "security tool." Forensic investigations revealed it was used to spy on journalists, lawyers defending political prisoners, human rights activists, and business executives across 50 countries.

Simply receiving a specific message was enough for Pegasus to install itself completely and invisibly. Zero clicks required. The victim's camera activated. Their microphone listened. Their encrypted messages were read in plaintext.

Many victims only discovered they had been spied on years later through forensic analysis. School devices are not immune — and students are not exempt.
